Yes. **My strongest starting recommendation is David F. Bradley, PhD**, in Bedford, NH. He specializes in OCD and anxiety, has extensive experience in residential and outpatient OCD treatment, received training at McLean Hospital’s OCD Institute and Dartmouth-Hitchcock, and offers telehealth to people in New Hampshire. He primarily treats adults. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/bradley-david-f/?utm_source=openai))

**Contact:** 603-634-9561 · dbradley@snhocdanxiety.com

Other promising options:

- **Colleen Porter, LCMHC, LMHC** — Based in Warner; her practice focuses heavily on OCD and anxiety and explicitly offers telehealth ERP, CBT, and ACT. She has specialized in OCD since 2018 and completed the IOCDF’s BTTI training. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/porter-colleen/?utm_source=openai))  
  **Contact:** 603-945-2028 · cporter@portercounselingllc.com

- **Elizabeth “Beth” Ohr, PsyD** — Licensed psychologist with more than 10 years treating OCD and anxiety-related disorders; trained at the University of Pennsylvania’s Center for the Treatment and Study of Anxiety and offers telehealth. She works with adults, teens, and parents. ([drbethohr.com](https://www.drbethohr.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Amiti Grozdon, MEd, LCMHC** — Provides statewide New Hampshire telehealth and specializes in OCD using ERP and Inference-Based CBT. Her practice lists insurance participation and a free 15-minute consultation. ([sagebrushcounseling.com](https://www.sagebrushcounseling.com/ocd-therapist-new-hampshire?utm_source=openai))

When you contact them, ask:

1. “How much of your practice is OCD treatment?”
2. “Do you provide structured ERP, including between-session exposure practice?”
3. “Are you accepting new telehealth clients, and do you take my insurance?”
4. “Do you treat my specific presentation—such as relationship OCD, contamination, scrupulosity, harm OCD, or primarily mental compulsions?”

Availability and insurance participation can change, so I’d contact **Dr. Bradley and one or two others** rather than relying on a single referral. The IOCDF notes that provider-directory information is self-reported, although licensure and BTTI completion are verified for listed providers. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/porter-colleen/?utm_source=openai))
